Sobre a OceanPact

A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar. Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.

Estamos em busca de um Oficial de Quarto de Náutica experiente e motivado para atuar em nossa área da Navegação, que compartilhe dos nossos valores contribuindo com exercicio de suas funções com segurança. Requisitos

Obrigatórios:

  • Formação EFOMM/ACON/ASON
  • DP Full
  • Regra II/1
  • Certificações marítimas/CIR dentro da Validade
  • Certificados BOMBAV/HLO
  • Inlges Fluente

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência précia em Flotel
  • Experiência prévia em apoio marítimo

Local de trabalho

  • Embarcado

O que buscamos

Queremos pessoas que se identifiquem com os nossos valores:

  • Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade
  • O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência
  • Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento
  • Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas
  • Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias
  • Resultados: foco em entregas com valor

O que oferecemos

  • Pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado, com salário fixo e benefícios competitivos
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico, para você e sua família, porque cuidar de quem cuida importa
  • Vale-refeição e/ou alimentação, além de vale-transporte (ou auxílio mobilidade, conforme o modelo de trabalho)
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, seguro e ético, onde o cuidado com as pessoas e o mar são levados a sério
  • Oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento profissional, com participação em projetos relevantes, treinamentos e contato com equipes multidisciplinares
  • Cultura forte e propósito claro, em uma empresa brasileira sólida, que cresce com responsabilidade e inovação
  • Estabilidade e confiança, em uma organização que atua com excelência e compromisso no setor marítimo e offshore

title: Head of Legal
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets , requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process.

  • Enable the company to scale effectively through strong legal foundations
  • Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions , from operations to international expansion
  • Structure and support complex, cross-border deals and partnerships
  • Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management across all activities
  • Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People
  • Strengthen investor confidence through clear and reliable legal frameworks
  • Manage external network of trusted legal advisors

Core working relationships

  • Directly reporting to the CFO.
  • Internal: Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors
  • External: Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodies

Context of the role:

  • You will join a lean and evolving legal function , with high ownership from day one
  • Legal demand is rapidly growing alongside company scale
  • Strong need to connect legal across international teams (Science, Carbon, BD)
  • The role has potential to evolve into VP Legal , depending on scope and impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the central legal hub across all company functions, both locally (Brazil) and internationally
  • Lead due diligence processes (legal and regulatory)
  • Structure, negotiate, and manage complex contracts , including:
    • Farmers, Mining partners, NDAs, Joint ventures, International commercial agreements, Corporate documentation (e.g. Investment agreements)
  • Own cross-border legal strategy and execution
  • Strengthen and improve corporate governance and entity structures (Brazil & international)
  • Work closely with tax advisors
  • Ensure compliance across multiple regulatory domains , including environmental, mining, agribusiness, and carbon markets
  • Support the People Team with labour and service provision requirement
  • Support investor relations from a legal standpoint
  • Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructure

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)
  • 8–15+ years of experience , ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors
  • Proven experience in:
    • Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle
    • Due diligence (legal & regulatory)
    • Complex contract structuring and negotiation
    • International contracts and cross-border operations
  • Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.g., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)
  • Solid experience with:
    • Corporate law and governance
    • Investor relations and strategic partnerships
  • Fluency in English , with experience working in international environments

Key Qualities

  • Business-oriented mindset : understands legal as a driver of growth
  • Highly relational : strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions
  • Strategic thinker : connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks
  • Pragmatic and solution-driven : balances risk with execution speed
  • High ownership : comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure
  • Strong institutional presence : capable of representing the company externally
  • Structured and integrative : able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains
  • Neutral and sound judgment , especially in complex or sensitive matters

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets
  • Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms
  • Exposure to governance and international structures
  • Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)
  • Business and legal experience in Germany
  • Speaks German
  • Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SP

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Equity to feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negocio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Objetivo da posição

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade éa sua chance. Nessa posição de Analista Pleno de CRM, você vai somar ao time de CRM para gerenciar todos os pontos de contato com o usuário da OLX, fazendo interface com os times de Produto, Tech e Marketing, a fim de entregar à pessoa usuária uma jornada de comunicação personalizada e fluída no melhor momento e no canal mais adequado.

E o que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?
  • Entender e gerir a jornada de comunicação da pessoa usuária das nossas plataformas;
  • Implementar melhorias nas réguas e jornadas existentes de relacionamento e processos da área;
  • Gerenciar o calendário de comunicações pontuais;
  • Acompanhar e reportar a performance das ações realizadas;
  • Identificar novas oportunidades de comunicações através da análise de padrões de comportamento das pessoas usuárias;
  • Gestão de canais (e-mail marketing, push, webpush, whatsapp, comunicação inapp/ inbrowser, entre outros);
  • Conhecer o funil de conversão e as dores da pessoa usuária, para ser assertivo em explorar comunicações que facilitem a navegação desde a entrada até a conversão;
  • Criação de comunicações automatizadas, personalizadas e escaláveis;
  • Participar de forma efetiva na definição de estratégias de comunicação de campanhas.
  • Ter uma forte noção de como entregamos valor para as nossas pessoas usuárias e de como podemos ajudar a OLX a fazer isso cada vez mais e melhor!

Requisitos e qualificações

E o que você precisa ter?
  • Experiência prévia na área de Marketing em CRM;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de criação, execução e gestão de campanhas de marketing, como por exemplo , Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, entre outras;
  • Ser capaz de realizar planejamentos e gerir campanhas de CRMde forma organizada;
  • Experiência em análise de KPIs no mercado digital;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office (Excel intermediário);
  • Experiência com gestão de relacionamento com stakeholders visando entender novas oportunidades de alavancar indicadores, solicitar criação de peças e demais conteúdo para as comunicações;
  • Desejável: conhecimento de HTML e queries;
  • Perfil analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Graduação em Administração, Negócios, Marketing, Engenharia, Tecnologia, etc).

Informações adicionais

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

title: VENDEDOR EXTERNO - BONSUCESSO (CORRETORA PARCEIRA VITAL LATINA) (811)
description:
Empresa VITAL LATINA corretora parceira da Sinaf Seguros está em expansão e está contratando Vendedor Externo!
Buscamos candidatos apaixonados por vendas e prontos para fazer a diferença. Esse é você? Então venha fazer parte de uma equipe de sucesso e conquiste seus sonhos!
Estamos em plena expansão e iremos formar 10 times campeões de venda até dezembro. Se você é uma pessoa motivada, resiliente e com habilidades de comunicação, aqui é seu lugar.
Nossa empresa é reconhecida por sua solidez e compromisso com a excelência no atendimento ao cliente. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, onde o crescimento pessoal e profissional andam juntos e são valorizados.

Responsável por prospectar novos clientes por meio de abordagem externa, por telefone, redes sociais e em plantões de atendimento;

Realizar entrevistas premiadas, apresentando e ofertando os produtos e serviços da empresa contratante (Sinaf Seguros);

Fechar novos contratos (venda de produtos e serviços) com o objetivo de atingir sua meta;

Administrar e fazer a manutenção da sua carteira clientes, de forma a mantê-los adimplentes por, pelo menos, as 6 (seis) primeiras parcelas do contrato e plenamente satisfeitos com a empresa.

Fazer a retenção dos clientes que pretendem cancelar o serviço antes do prazo de 6 meses.

Promover ações regulares de relacionamento com os clientes ativos ou não da sua carteira;

Requisitos

Organização, disciplina, determinação e constância

Gostar de trabalhar com venda externa e por telefone

Ter como objetivo ganhos acima de 3 mil reais em 2 anos

Desejável vivência em vendas

Escolaridade mínima: Ensino Médio - Concluído

Observações

  • ASSISTÊNCIA FUNERAL
  • SEGURO DE VIDA ACIDENTES PESSOAIS
  • VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO
  • VALE REFEIÇÃO
  • VALE TRANSPORTE (não se aplica para trabalho 100% remoto)

Oferecemos formação profissional em nossa Escola de Vendas por um período de 60 dias. Durante esse período, você será contratado como Promotor de Vendas com uma carga horária diária de 6 horas. Nossa Escola de Vendas está localizada no centro do Rio de Janeiro , onde você participará de atividades práticas e teóricas, aprendendo sobre o nosso produto, técnicas de vendas e ferramentas de trabalho. Uma vez aprovado após o período de formação, será promovido a Vendedor Júnior estando apto para se tornar um vendedor de sucesso e será alocado na unidade mais próxima a sua residência, com carga horária diária de trabalho normal.

Se você está pronto para abraçar essa oportunidade e crescer junto com a nossa empresa, cadastre-se na vaga.
Estamos animados para recebê-lo em nossa equipe de sucesso!

title: Banco de Talentos | Líder Técnico
description:
Somos o acelerador que impulsiona o crescimento na Ibero-América, combinando a excelência global em engenharia da EPAM com a experiência regional e a proximidade cultural da NEORIS . Ajudamos as organizações a escalar, modernizar e avançar em sua transformação digital por meio de soluções em Cloud, Data & Analytics, Inteligência Artificial, Cibersegurança, Automação Inteligente, Consultoria Estratégica e Engenharia de Software.

Respaldados por mais de 60.000 profissionais em mais de 55 países e por um sólido modelo Nearshore, conectamos capacidades globais com confiança local para gerar impacto real, crescimento sustentável e resultados de alto valor para nossos clientes.

Acreditamos que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação. Por isso, todas as nossas oportunidades estão abertas para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, raça, idade, identidade, orientação ou condição.

Formato de contratação: CLT + Benefícios

Descrição do Cargo

Buscamos um Líder Técnico para atuar na liderança de times multidisciplinares, garantindo a excelência técnica das soluções, alinhamento com as necessidades de negócio e evolução contínua da arquitetura e dos produtos. Essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir decisões técnicas, apoiar o time, remover impedimentos e garantir entregas de alto impacto com qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente squads de desenvolvimento, promovendo boas práticas, padrões de arquitetura e qualidade de código.
  • Atuar de forma hands‑on quando necessário, apoiando o time em decisões técnicas, troubleshooting e implementações críticas.
  • Conduzir discussões técnicas, reviews de código e definição de padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Desenhar, propor e validar arquiteturas escaláveis, seguras e resilientes.
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e soluções, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Escrever e validar especificações técnicas, estimativas de esforço e documentação de sistemas.
  • Orquestrar integrações entre sistemas internos e externos, garantindo padrões e governança.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com POs, PMs e áreas de negócio para entender necessidades, priorizar demandas e apoiar decisões.
  • Contribuir em refinamentos, discoveries, planejamento e acompanhamento da evolução das sprints.
  • Garantir observabilidade, monitoramento e desempenho dos sistemas.

Sustentação & Operações

  • Apoiar na sustentação dos sistemas, gestão de incidentes e análise de riscos.
  • Implementar ou orientar melhorias em monitoramento, logs, automações e pipelines.
  • Apoiar processos de implantação, rollback, troubleshooting e melhoria de performance.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós‑graduação ou MBA em Arquitetura de Software, Gestão de TI ou afins serão considerados diferenciais.

Linguagens e Frameworks

Arquitetura & Integrações

  • Microsserviços, APIs REST, mensageria (Kafka), C4 Model, BPMN, integrações corporativas.
  • Design Patterns, testes automatizados (JUnit), SonarQube, práticas de segurança, observabilidade (Grafana/NewRelic).
  • Experiência prévia como arquiteto, SRE, especialista em integrações ou liderança de times ágeis.
  • Atuação prévia com chatbots, automações ou soluções de alta criticidade.
  • Certificações (Scrum, ITIL, AWS, Azure, Arquitetura).
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação: Benefícios mensais para suas despesas com alimentação, dentro e fora de casa.
  • Previdência Privada: Planejamento de futuro com contribuição complementar à aposentadoria.
  • Plano de Saúde: Cobertura médica de alta qualidade para você e seu dependente legal.
  • Seguro de Vida: Proteção e segurança para você e seus entes queridos.
  • Aulas de Inglês/Espanhol: Incentivo ao aprendizado de idiomas.
  • Wellhub: Benefícios e descontos em academias e programas de bem-estar.
  • Auxílio Creche: Suporte financeiro para despesas com educação infantil.
  • Neoris Global Campus: Plataforma de desenvolvimento com oportunidades contínuas de aprendizado e crescimento profissional.

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

The Technical Implementation Specialist is responsible for bridging the gap between our core LPPA extraction tool engine and our clients’ downstream internal systems. You are essentially the "Last Mile" problem solver. While our platform excels at turning unstructured investment documents into structured data, our clients cannot realize the full value of that data if it doesn't "talk" to their existing downstream systems (like eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs). You will be responsible for solving the "Last Mile" delivery problem—ensuring that the data we extract is not just accurate, but immediately actionable within the client's unique technical ecosystem. This involves navigating complex data mapping, managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, and acting as the go‑to for delivering bespoke integration solutions in the template the client needs under tight deadlines.

The team's core mission is to solve the "Last Mile" problem in data delivery and utilization, specifically focusing on custom integration.

Our platform excels at transforming unstructured investment documents into structured data. However, this data only achieves its full value when it seamlessly integrates with a client's existing downstream systems (such as eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs).

The Custom Integration Lead acts as the crucial bridge between our core data extraction engine and these client‑specific systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the extracted data is immediately actionable within the client's unique technical environment.

This involves:

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients requiring custom delivery solutions.
  • Analyze client downstream system requirements to draft comprehensive Functional & Technical Specification files.
  • Navigating complex data mapping requirements.
  • Managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures.
  • Leading a technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in the client‑required format and under tight deadlines.
  • Facilitate daily stand‑ups to track progress, remove blockers, and ensure alignment with the delivery roadmap.
  • Perform Internal QA on custom templates (Excel, CSV, JSON) to ensure 100% accuracy against the signed‑off specifications.
  • Act as the first line of defense for production issues: perform initial triage and investigation of reported bugs.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Custom Integrations Team, a specialized engineering and delivery pod within the broader R&D and Implementation/delivery teams.

Our team is the critical link between our core LPPA engine and the production environments of the world’s leading Limited Partners (LPs). We are a high‑impact, agile unit consisting of a Lead, a Tech Lead, and Developers, dedicated to architecting bespoke data transformation and delivery solutions. By ensuring our data integrates seamlessly into diverse downstream systems, we directly enable our clients to achieve real‑time visibility into their private market investments. Our work is the final, essential step in the value chain, turning raw extracted data into a functional, automated asset for our customers.

About You

We are looking for a collaborative and detail‑oriented lead who enjoys the challenge of turning complex data into seamless client solutions.

  • Technical Liaison. You act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients, translating complex downstream system requirements into comprehensive Functional and Technical Specification files.
  • Integration Architect. You are adept at navigating complex data mapping requirements and are familiar with secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, including APIs, SFTP, SharePoint, and Cloud Storage.
  • Agile Delivery Lead. You are comfortable leading a specialized technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in client‑required formats while maintaining alignment with strict delivery roadmaps and deadlines.
  • Operational Driver. You are familiar with tools like Jira and Confluence, using them to govern the full development lifecycle, prioritize backlogs, document technical specs, and facilitate daily stand‑ups to remove blockers.
  • Quality. You take a hands‑on approach to Internal QA, ensuring 100% accuracy against signed‑off specifications before any data is delivered to a stakeholder.
  • First‑Line Responder. You act as the first line of defense for production issues, performing the initial triage and root‑cause investigation of reported bugs before prioritizing engineering tickets.
  • 3+ years of experience recommended in technical implementation, integration engineering, or technical project management.

title: Senior Security Engineer (GRC)
description:
About us

Nubank was founded in 2013 with the mission of fighting complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. Today, we are one of the largest digital banking platforms in the world, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our careers page:

About the team

The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to remain compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership.

The GRC squad collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to align our technology security strategy with Nubank’s overall business objectives, ensuring that identified risks are mitigated and that risk-based decision-making is enabled within and beyond the IT & Security Business Unit.

About the role

You will be responsible for acting as a technical reference in security, certifications, and internal controls, serving as a bridge between engineering, risk, audit, and business stakeholders.

You will define strategies, support risk-based decision-making, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are effectively embedded into processes, systems, and products.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as a senior technical and governance reference across security, certifications, risk, and internal controls, influencing strategy.
  • Identify control gaps and improvement opportunities in technical procedures required for certification and recertification processes (e.g., ISO 27001, PCI‑DSS).
  • Develop and maintain strong partnerships with business and technical leaders to orchestrate audits, assessments, and remediation plans in a risk‑based and scalable way.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to define action plans that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.
  • Conduct assessments of internal controls, ensuring adherence to internal policies, legal requirements, and industry standards.
  • Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the internal controls landscape and lead control reviews, ensuring timely resolution of issues.
  • Work closely with Risk teams to align on the mitigation of identified risks.
  • Support responses to audit requests, regulatory inquiries, and due diligence from business partners.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, IT, and global teams to integrate compliance and security requirements into processes and systems.
  • Define and monitor KRIs and KPIs, delivering forward‑looking, data‑driven insights to senior management and Committees.
  • Drive continuous improvement and scale, simplifying processes and strengthening Nubank’s Security Maturity as the company grows globally.

Qualification Requirements

  • Solid experience in information security, with strong knowledge of frameworks such as PCI‑DSS, ISO 27000 family, NIST, and similar.
  • Prior experience with security certification processes and/or internal controls, compliance, and audit support.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees.
  • Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Security Information, Risk Management or related fields.
  • Familiarity with using AI and automation (e.g., machine learning, generative AI, or LLM‑based tooling) to enhance security compliance use cases.
  • Knowledge of the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services, such as SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, ANBIMA, SEC, and related regulations.
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP) and implementing security controls in these contexts.
  • Advanced English (written and verbal) required.

Nice to have Requirements

  • Relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, Security+, CISSP, or CISM are considered a strong plus.

International experience is highly desirable.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Credit Card Core Platforms
description:
Principal Software Engineer - Credit Card Core Platforms

Sr Staff Software Engineer - CC Core Platforms

About Nubank Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 123 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. The Company is preparing for its next growth cycle where it will accelerate its internationalization process outside Latin America, and will also enter new verticals beyond financial services in its core markets taking advantage of the significant customer penetration.

About the role We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical evolution of our Credit Card platform. This is not a traditional maintenance role. You will be the architect of a profound transformation: leveraging Generative AI to automate complex operational tasks and orchestrating the global migration from our current systems to a unified, future-proof architecture. You will be a key partner to the Engineering Leadership and a reference for the entire engineering community.

Mission Your goal is to design and operationalize a technical strategy that uses AI to increase operational efficiency while accelerating our global migration, ensuring:

  • Intelligent Maintenance: Implementing AI agents to analyze tickets and crashes, automating resolutions for the global credit card environment.
  • Seamless Migration: Leading the coexistence strategy between legacy and new platforms across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, ensuring data integrity and a flawless customer experience.
  • Technical Excellence: Solving deep architectural bottlenecks in high-scale distributed systems and raising the bar for software design globally.

Core Responsibilities

  • Migration Strategy: Define the long-term roadmap for decommissioning legacy systems, starting with the 1-year migration plan for the Colombian market.
  • AI-Driven Engineering: Architect and integrate AI solutions (cloud-based agents) to automate infrastructure maintenance and data migration.
  • Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with General Managers, PMs, and Staff+ ICs to align technical decisions with business needs across different countries.
  • Mentorship & Culture: Mentor senior engineers, fostering a culture of pragmatism, excellence in distributed systems, and the adoption of cutting-edge AI tools.
  • Navigating Complexity: You will work on high-scale systems supporting millions of transactions where every decision impacts customer limits and billing.

A posição de Especialista Jurídico Sênior é responsável por executar as seguintes atividades, com certo nível de autonomia, em alinhamento com as orientações do Gerente Jurídico e do Diretor de Jurídico, Assuntos Regulatórios e Governança Corporativa:

  1. Assessoria Jurídica Estratégica: Prestar assessoria jurídica e regulatória estratégica aos clientes internos, como equipes de Joint Ventures (JVs), em matérias administrativas, societárias, ambientais, cíveis, regulatórias de E&P e contenciosas.
  2. Elaboração e Negociação Contratual: Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos comerciais, societários e operacionais relevantes, assegurando alinhamento com os modelos da TTE (quando aplicável), com os requisitos legais e com os objetivos do negócio.
  3. Suporte à Governança de JVs: Apoiar as joint ventures em processos de governança, identificando riscos jurídicos, propondo medidas de mitigação e garantindo a conformidade ao longo do ciclo de vida dos projetos.
  4. Relacionamento com Stakeholders e Autoridades: Atuar junto a partes externas, como autoridades governamentais, parceiros de joint ventures e associações do setor, apoiando o posicionamento jurídico da companhia e protegendo seus direitos e obrigações.
  5. Resolução de Conflitos: Recomendar e implementar estratégias e conduzir processos de resolução de disputas, incluindo arbitragens de alto valor, processos administrativos e judiciais, assegurando estratégia coerente, adequada avaliação de riscos e coordenação eficaz com escritórios externos.
  6. Monitoramento Legal e Regulatório e Avaliação de Impactos no Negócio: Monitorar evoluções legais e regulatórias que impactem as atividades de E&P e assessorar o negócio quanto a impactos, riscos e medidas de implementação necessárias.
  7. Coordenação de Escritórios Externos: Coordenar as atividades com escritórios de advocacia externos e especialistas, garantindo consistência estratégica e alto padrão de entregáveis.
  8. Representação e Atuação Institucional: Representar a companhia em comitês externos (ex.: IBP) e organizações do setor, liderando iniciativas de advocacy em matérias jurídicas e regulatórias e protegendo os ativos, a reputação e a licença social para operar no longo prazo.
  9. Reporte à Gestão: Reportar de forma consistente e buscar orientação da gestão em assuntos que envolvam elevada exposição financeira ou impacto reputacional.
  10. One Maestro: Atuar em conformidade com os princípios de HSSSE e One Maestro, visando proteger os ativos, a reputação e a licença de longo prazo para operar da companhia.

Experiência jurídica em nível sênior, com sólido conhecimento do arcabouço regulatório brasileiro e da prática internacional, especialmente em Leis do Petróleo e regulamentações da ANP. Experiência em estruturas contratuais sofisticadas de E&P é um diferencial, incluindo estruturas complexas de governança em múltiplos regimes jurídicos (PSC, Concessão), unitizações, redeterminações, bem como contratos de serviços técnicos (EPCIs e outros).

title: Transportation Specialist, ROC
description:
ROC (Relay Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, EU, India, Mexico, Brazil etc. It ensures hassle free, timely pick‑up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with tactical problem solving ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Overview of a Transportation Specialist

A Transportation Specialist at ROC facilitates the flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impact customer experience and business continuity. The role works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations. Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationships, ensuring that freight is picked‑up on time and delivered to FC as per the given appointment. Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationships, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC to deliver customer orders as per promise. A Transportation Specialist provides timely resolution by researching and querying internal tools, taking real‑time decisions, analyzing data, noticing trends, and driving customer experience without compromising on time. The ideal candidate should understand basic logistics, communicate clearly in written and oral form, ideate process improvements, and drive them to completion.

  • Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, measuring and identifying activities performed
  • Quickly understand the business impact of trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data

title: Research Assistant
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

Howard University is currently seeking a highly motivated and organized Research Assistant to work on a federally funded research study related to COVID-19. The Research Assistants will be primarily responsible for recruiting potential adult participants at Howard University Hospital in Washington DC and the neighboring communities. Participants to be enrolled for the study are past COVID-19 patients. The study seeks to assess Long COVID prevalence and associated risk factors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Screen electronic medical records to identify eligible study participants, contact potential participants in a timely manner.
  • Obtain informed consent in accordance with research protocols, procedures, and good clinical practice guidelines.
  • Administer survey assessments and enter data in REDCap.
  • Perform and document risk assessments.
  • Attend mandatory study specific trainings and team meetings.
  • Complete and file daily paperwork accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Organize and maintain study participants’ data and extract medical data as needed.
  • Document accurate encounters and shift events, adhere to all study procedures, and communicate daily/weekly updates to study coordinator and recruitment lead.
  • Assist the follow-up team in preparing participants’ scheduling and completing follow-up visits virtually and in person.
  • Other duties deemed necessary to maintain smooth operations of the research program such as biospecimen preparation, packaging and mailing to the biorepository core.

Core Competencies

As a critical component to the success of the study, the primary responsibility of the Research Assistants will be patients’ engagement, community outreach, and participants’ enrollment in the study. Personable, detail-oriented, flexible with scheduling, able to work independently and as part of a team.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Sciences, Public Health or health-related fields.

Previous research experience, clinic/hospital work or volunteer experience, and knowledge of the research process is preferred. This position requires flexibility and availability to adapt to patients’ schedules. Reliable transportation is necessary to complete participants’ interviews at various community locations. Spanish language is a plus.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$40,000-$50,000

#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Quais Empresas De Ônibus No RJ Estão Contratando Motorista
description:
✅ Empresas de ônibus como Viação Redentor, Real Auto Ônibus e Transportes Flores estão contratando motoristas no RJ.

Atualmente, várias empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro estão com processos seletivos abertos para a contratação de motoristas. Essas oportunidades são frequentes devido à alta demanda por profissionais capacitados para atuar no transporte público, sobretudo em grandes centros urbanos como o RJ. Entre as empresas que estão contratando, destacam-se companhias que operam linhas municipais, intermunicipais e interestaduais, oferecendo vagas que normalmente exigem CNH categoria D ou E, além de experiência comprovada.

Este artigo detalha quais são as principais empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro que estão contratando motoristas atualmente, explicando os requisitos básicos para se candidatar, as formas de inscrição e os benefícios que essas empresas costumam oferecer. Além disso, abordamos dicas importantes para quem deseja ingressar nessa área, incluindo informações sobre o mercado de trabalho, a demanda por motoristas e os cuidados para escolher a vaga ideal.

Empresas de ônibus no RJ com vagas abertas para motoristas

  • Viação 1001 – Atua nas linhas interestaduais e intermunicipais, frequentemente buscando motoristas com experiência e CNH categoria D ou E.
  • Viação São Silvestre – Opera linhas municipais em vários bairros do RJ e costuma abrir vagas para motoristas, principalmente em períodos de alta demanda.
  • Auto Viação Jabour – Empresa tradicional no transporte público urbano do RJ, que em algumas épocas contrata profissionais para reforço em suas operações.
  • Viação Novo Rio – Especializada em linhas urbanas e rodoviárias, frequentemente disponibiliza vagas para motoristas qualificados.
  • Viação Redentor – Conhecida pelo transporte intermunicipal, mantém processos seletivos regulares para motoristas profissionais.

Requisitos legais e habilitação

Antes de mais nada, o candidato precisa possuir Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) na categoria D ou E , que permite a condução de veículos com mais de 8 passageiros . Além disso, a Certificação de Curso MOPP (Movimentação Operacional de Produtos Perigosos) pode ser exigida por algumas empresas, especialmente para linhas que eventualmente transportem cargas específicas.

  • CNH categoria D ou E válida e regularizada;
  • Comprovante de residência atualizado;
  • Certificado do curso MOPP (quando aplicável);
  • Atestado de saúde ocupacional para garantir aptidão física e mental;
  • Currículo atualizado com experiência comprovada na função.

Requisitos comuns para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • CNH categoria D ou E: obrigatória para condução de veículos de transporte coletivo.
  • Experiência comprovada: muitas empresas exigem no mínimo 1 a 2 anos de experiência como motorista de ônibus.
  • Curso de Transporte Coletivo: certificado pelo DETRAN, necessário para alguns processos seletivos.
  • Exame médico e psicológico: para garantir a aptidão física e mental do candidato.
  • Disponibilidade de horário: Muitas vagas exigem trabalho em turnos, finais de semana e feriados.

Competências Comportamentais e Técnicas

  • Responsabilidade e atenção redobrada ao trafegar em vias urbanas e rodoviárias sob condições variadas;
  • Boa comunicação para lidar com passageiros e equipe;
  • Conhecimento das rotas e pontos turísticos do RJ;
  • Capacidade de resolução rápida de problemas e situações de emergência;
  • Resistência física para longas jornadas de trabalho.

Benefícios comuns oferecidos para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica e planos de carreira são comuns nas empresas do setor.

Média salarial para motoristas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro

A média varia entre R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000, dependendo da empresa, turno e benefícios oferecidos.

Pontos-chave sobre Contratação de Motoristas de Ônibus no RJ

  • Empresas principais: Viação 1001, Viação Penha, Auto Viação Redentor, Viação Sul Fluminense.
  • Requisitos: CNH D, experiência anterior, curso especializado em transporte coletivo.
  • Salário médio: R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000 mensais, com benefícios inclusos.
  • Onde buscar vagas: Sites oficiais, plataformas de emprego (InfoJobs, Indeed, LinkedIn).
  • Processo seletivo: Pode incluir testes práticos, entrevistas e análise de documentação.
  • Benefícios comuns: Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica, seguro de vida.
  • Mercado: Alta demanda por motoristas qualificados devido ao transporte coletivo urbano no RJ.

title: Brazil Hull Plan Approval Engineer
description:
Mission

This role focuses on performing detailed plan and design reviews, resolving issues related to conflicting design requirements, ensuring client requirements and applicable standards are met. Projects could include the approval of new building, conversion, and existing vessels and yachts.

Key Accountabilities

  • Review and approve hull structural drawings of ships, offshore units, and marine equipment, in compliance with Class Rules and Statutory Regulations, for new buildings, ships in service, and ship’s conversions.
  • Assist clients during the design and construction phase, providing guidance and support related to structural design.
  • Resolve issues related to conflicting design requirements and material standards.
  • Perform assessments and provide specialist advice for service delivery, research or development work within agreed broad parameters that include budget constraints and contractual requirements.
  • Oversee and manage day-to-day project elements, visit sites to take measurements.
  • Ensure correct and up-to-date data is used and complete documentation is submitted to officials and other day-to-day duties.
  • Review the project deliverables (technical reports, project performance documentations and engineering drawings, etc).
  • Review progress reports and take appropriate action to ensure requirements are met.
  • Take ownership and responsibility over the financial progress of assigned tasks.
  • Understand and apply project management concepts providing feedback to project manager, serve as reference for the escalation of issues.
  • Manage simple and complex projects assigned applying project management concepts and techniques.
  • Assess complex structural problems for internal/external clients to determine solutions.
  • Answer complex contractor questions on behalf of the supervising engineer, and serve as liaisons between engineering and construction personnel.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Engineering

Qualifications

Experience

  • Experience in hull design, shipbuilding, or marine engineering, with a focus on plan approval in a Class Society or shipbuilding environment.
  • Experience in the review and approval of hull structural designs, stability calculations, and material selection, ensuring compliance with applicable rules and regulations.
  • Practical experience working with international maritime standards (SOLAS, MARPOL, etc.) and Class Society regulations.
  • In-depth experience in the hull plan approval process, including structural integrity verification, load distribution, and strength calculations.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced understanding of ship hull design principles, structural components, and materials used in hull construction.
  • Expertise in reviewing technical drawings, specifications, and stability calculations for hull structures to ensure compliance with design codes and Class Society standards.
  • Proficiency in software tools commonly used in hull plan approval and structural analysis, such as AutoCAD, NAPA, ShipConstructor, or other naval architecture and engineering software.
  • In-depth knowledge of materials used in hull construction, including steel grades, welding techniques, and corrosion protection methods.

Additional Information

  • Perform maintenance and repair of all MPD equipment inclusive of surface manifolds, RCD and MPD IRJ components and associated surface equipment such as the HPU, HCS, reels and accessories.

  • Competent in the use of the MPD control software.

Descrição da vaga

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Quais serão seus desafios:

  • Desenvolver o conceito e a estratégia de campanhas de incentivo (viagens, experiências, premiações e eventos proprietários);

  • Definir KPIs de sucesso (engajamento, performance, ROI e satisfação);

  • Atuar com visão crítica sobre propostas (escopo, custos, riscos e alternativas);
  • Elaborar e controlar budgets detalhados, com visão analítica e transparência de custos;
  • Acompanhar despesas por centro de custo, garantindo aderência ao planejado;
  • Buscar eficiência financeira sem comprometer a experiência;
  • Garantir a entrega impecável dos eventos (logística, conteúdo e experiência do participante);
  • Atuar presencialmente em eventos, gerenciando operação, fornecedores e imprevistos;
  • Supervisionar conteúdos (roteiros, apresentações, ativações e experiências);
  • Criar jornadas memoráveis para os participantes (pré, durante e pós-evento);
  • Desenvolver ações de relacionamento, reconhecimento e pertencimento;
  • Garantir comunicação clara, consistente e atrativa em todos os pontos de contato;
  • Analisar resultados das campanhas (KPIs, feedbacks e ROI);
  • Propor melhorias e inovações para ciclos futuros;
  • Estruturar relatórios executivos para liderança.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida com eventos corporativos e campanhas de incentivo;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos;
  • Forte habilidade em negociação e gestão de fornecedores;
  • Excel avançado (controle financeiro e análise de dados);
  • Desejável: Power BI;
  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), com capacidade de conduzir reuniões, negociações e gestão de fornecedores internacionais.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com eventos internacionais e logística complexa;
  • Vivência com público comercial (força de vendas);
  • Experiência com programas de incentivo de longo prazo.

title: Technical Implementations Specialist
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

The Technical Implementation Specialist is responsible for bridging the gap between our core LPPA extraction tool engine and our clients’ downstream internal systems. You are essentially the “Last Mile” problem solver. While our platform excels at turning unstructured investment documents into structured data, our clients cannot realize the full value of that data if it doesn't “talk” to their existing downstream systems (like eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs).

You will be responsible for solving the “Last Mile” delivery problem—ensuring that the data we extract is not just accurate, but immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical ecosystem. This involves navigating complex data mapping, managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, and acting as the go‑to for delivering bespoke integration solutions in the template the client needs under tight deadlines.

The team's core mission is to solve the “Last Mile” problem in data delivery and utilization, specifically focusing on custom integration. Our platform excels at transforming unstructured investment documents into structured data. However, this data only achieves its full value when it seamlessly integrates with a client's existing downstream systems (such as eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs). The Custom Integration Lead acts as the crucial bridge between our core data extraction engine and these client‑specific systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the extracted data is immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical environment.

This Involves

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients requiring custom delivery solutions.
  • Analyze client downstream system requirements to draft comprehensive Functional & Technical Specification files.
  • Navigating complex data mapping requirements.
  • Managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures.
  • Leading a technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in the client‑required format and under tight deadlines.
  • Facilitate daily stand‑ups to track progress, remove blockers, and ensure alignment with the delivery roadmap.
  • Perform Internal QA on custom templates (Excel, CSV, JSON) to ensure 100% accuracy against the signed‑off specifications.
  • Act as the first line of defense for production issues: perform initial triage and investigation of reported bugs.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Custom Integrations Team, a specialized engineering and delivery pod within the broader R&D and Implementation/delivery teams. Our team is the critical link between our core LPPA engine and the production environments of the world’s leading Limited Partners (LPs). We are a high‑impact, agile unit consisting of a Lead, a Tech Lead, and Developers, dedicated to architecting bespoke data transformation and delivery solutions. By ensuring our data integrates seamlessly into diverse downstream systems, we directly enable our clients to achieve real‑time visibility into their private market investments. Our work is the final, essential step in the value chain, turning raw extracted data into a functional, automated asset for our customers.

About You

  • Technical Liaison. You act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients, translating complex downstream system requirements into comprehensive Functional and Technical Specification files.
  • Integration Architect. You are adept at navigating complex data mapping requirements and are familiar with secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, including APIs, SFTP, SharePoint, and Cloud Storage.
  • Agile Delivery Lead. You are comfortable leading a specialized technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in client‑required formats while maintaining alignment with strict delivery roadmaps and deadlines.
  • Operational Driver. You are familiar with tools like Jira and Confluence, using them to govern the full development lifecycle, prioritize backlogs, document technical specs, and facilitate daily stand‑ups to remove blockers.
  • Quality : You take a hands‑on approach to Internal QA, ensuring 100% accuracy against signed‑off specifications before any data is delivered to a stakeholder.
  • First‑Line Responder. You act as the first line of defense for production issues, performing the initial triage and root‑cause investigation of reported bugs before prioritizing engineering tickets.
  • 3+ years of experience recommended in technical implementation, integration engineering, or technical project management.

Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager will help building and maintaining stadium seating maps for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Configuration and Inventory team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for the management of ticketing inventory, seating plans and its maintenance in the Ticketing System, ensuring data accuracy throughout the planning phase and during the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the central liaison to FIFA Zurich, facilitating alignment on strategic priorities, reporting, and operational updates
  • Provide hands‑on support and guidance to the local team, ensuring they have the resources, information, and leadership needed to deliver high‑quality operational outcomes
  • Support and build accurate seating plans in the ticketing system for FIFA tournament venues of the host country
  • Manage and oversee the implementation of all necessary seating information and configuration of spectator flows, price categories, seat allocations and carry out required updates
  • Maintain on day‑to‑day basis seating maps and configurations within the ticketing system throughout all stages of FIFA tournaments and apply changes as required
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy of all seating information and configuration
  • Evaluate outcomes of quality inspections and propose corrective measures
  • Carry out the seat allocation and seat assignment process in the ticketing system
  • Assess and analyse maps and plans of FIFA tournament venues to identify gaps and changes to be applied in the seating plans and configurations
  • Plan, prepare and carry out on‑site seat inspection visits to fully validate seating plans as built in the ticketing system with the actual venue seating
  • Support the overall management of ticketing inventory by conducting quality assurance measures for both ticket quotas and seat allocations
  • Administer allocations and additional ticket requests during the tournaments
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education
  • Experience working with ticketing systems (preferably Secutix)
  • 5 years of professional experience
  • 1–3 years of experience in ticketing or similar functional area (first experiences in creating seating maps or floor plans in a software application of advantage)

  • Experience in working with CAD technical drawings
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities
  • Ability to coordinate across functional areas such as security, broadcasting, hospitality
  • Strong analytical skills, detail‑oriented, technology‑minded, efficient and accountable team player
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:

Employment Type: Fixed Term

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

About Yinson

Yinson is a leading global integrated offshore production company committed to fostering innovation and sustainability. We pride ourselves on a culture that values teamwork, excellence, and proactive problem‑solving, ensuring that every team member contributes to a sustainable future. Our vision is to become a world‑class provider of integrated energy solutions, and your role as an intern will play a significant part in this journey.

Core Responsibilities

  • Assist the Onshore Team in monitoring and controlling daily operations, ensuring compliance with company standards and contributing to overall operational efficiency.
  • Manage communication with subcontractors and suppliers, ensuring timely and quality delivery of services and materials to bolster operational success.
  • Collaborate with various departments to meet both vessel and global demands, aiding in the enhancement of interdepartmental synergy and response capabilities.
  • Participate in workshops focused on Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) practices, including Task Risk Analysis and Critical Analysis, to heighten safety awareness and operational readiness.
  • Engage in client meetings to understand contracts and operational responsibilities, enhancing your educational experience.
  • Support the operations interface, promoting seamless interactions across all onshore and offshore departments.

Duties

  • Assist the Onshore Team in maintaining the Operations Management System and the Computerized Maintenance Management System, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.
  • Review and update procedures, work instructions, and job descriptions, aligning them with best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Draft documentation for Purchasing Order/Contract issuance, including Scopes of Work and Technical Analyses.
  • Participate in audits and inspections to assess the compliance and effectiveness of operational processes.
  • Monitor and document the status of material embarkation and disembarkation as well as third‑party mobilisations and payments, relaying essential updates to the team.
  • All internship activities will be conducted onshore; please note the intern will not embark offshore.
  • Engage in quarterly feedback sessions with your supervisor to discuss performance, challenges, and growth opportunities.
  • By the end of the internship, you will be well‑versed in articulating the fundamentals of oil, gas, and water topsides, as well as marine processes related to cargo storage, handling, and offloading.

Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Responsibilities

  • Maintain a keen awareness of health and safety practices, proactively observing and reporting any unsafe activities, conditions, or situations.
  • Utilise the 'Stop Work' policy whenever unsafe conditions are noted, prioritising safety in all operational undertakings.

Qualifications

  • Mandatory: Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in engineering, with a commitment to a two-year internship.
  • Desirable: Coursework in technical subjects related to operations or engineering.

Skills & Experiences

  • Mandatory: Basic understanding of English and proficiency in MS Office applications.
  • Desirable: Intermediate level of English to facilitate clear communication in a multinational team environment.

Non‑Negotiables

  • Ensure the Core Competencies of the greater organization are embraced.
  • Live the Rules: Treat the Life‑Saving Rules as non‑negotiable principles that guide your daily decisions and routines.
  • Lead by Example: Show your commitment through your actions and inspire others to do the same.

  • Educate and Share: Continue fostering conversations about the Life‑Saving Rules within your teams, ensuring everyone understands their importance and application.

  • Goals: Focus on and execute your most important goals.
  • Vision: Together we will continue to enhance, grow and transform.

PROJECTS Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Work with the Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer to develop Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies for offshore and onshore projects.
  • Provide key inputs for engineering and planning to be developed.
  • Define and order equipment and installation aids.
  • Specify and identify suitable Pre‑Commissioning spreads and vessels.
  • Prepare Task Plans with support from Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer.
  • Review of Subcontractor Pre‑Commissioning procedures.
  • Prepare Readiness review, Constructability, HAZID.
  • Conduct site visits.
  • Prepare Master Equipment List.
  • Procurement of materials and services.
  • Interface with Pre‑Commissioning Subcontractor on deck layouts. Obtain seafastening packages for vessel spreads and interface with installation team.
  • Equipment inventory, preservation and staging for each mobilization.
  • Attend function tests.
  • Mobilize Pre‑Commissioning equipment and vessels to execute work scopes.
  • Arrange the testing and load‑out of Pre‑Commissioning equipment and installation aids.
  • Coordinate the execution of onshore & offshore Pre‑Commissioning work scopes.
  • Coordinate the demobilization of the Pre‑Commissioning equipment, marine spread and the off‑hire of subcontract equipment.
  • Work at site (onshore and offshore) as required by the project.
  • Prepare MOC's with support from Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer.
  • Compile and issue Site Memo’s and maintain system completion plan.
  • Compile and present return of experience and lesson learned documents.
  • To train and mentor Field Engineers.
  • Work with the Pre‑Commissioning Technical Authority to align on Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies.
  • Preparation of subcontractor scopes of works.
  • Manage Pre‑Commissioning subcontracts.
  • Daily Progress Reporting.

TENDERS Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Assists the Pre‑Commissioning Technical Authority in preparation of technical and commercial build‑ups following the Tendering work instruction.
  • Liaise with installation team during tender phase to ensure alignment on methodologies.
  • Work with the Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer to develop Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies for offshore and onshore tenders.
  • Engineering and planning for the timely execution of the work scope.
  • Specify and identify suitable Pre‑Commissioning spreads and vessels.
  • Reviewing of internal and external deliverables (specifications, standards, drawings, reports, procedures, risk assessments, scopes of work, subcontracts).
  • Prepare installation aids requirements.
  • Prepare subcontractor/vendor scopes of works and subsequent technical bid clarification.
  • Prepare pre‑commissioning method statements where required.
  • To train and mentor Field Engineers.
  • Attend site visits where applicable.
  • Technical bid clarification.
  • Provide input into Technical Bid Evaluation process.

Interfaces

The Senior Field Engineer will maintain strong interfaces with the various disciplines within the business line. The main interfaces for Pre‑Commissioning are:

  • Marine Operations Engineers
  • Engineering
  • SCM
  • QHSES
  • Environmental Specialists
  • Vessel Operations Managers
  • Marine Construction Manager
  • Tender Manager

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 7 plus years of experience in the oil and gas industry working for major Contractors.
  • Experience managing a team of more than 2 Engineers.
  • The following experience is required:
    • General experience of all shallow and deepwater water installation operations.
    • Rigid & flexible pipeline Pre‑Commissioning experience - execution of a minimum of 8 projects.
    • Umbilical pre‑commissioning experience - execution of a minimum of 4 projects.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.
  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

description:
Somos um grupo que tem como missão democratizar o acesso à saúde privada e ser referência em solução de saúde ambulatorial no Rio de Janeiro.

Buscamos um profissional que possa garantir assistência médica segura e eficaz por meio da execução de procedimentos clínicos e cirúrgicos, contribuindo para a recuperação e bem-estar dos pacientes.

Atividades

SPA

  • Realizar medição de sinais vitais (pressão arterial, temperatura, frequência cardíaca, respiratória, saturação de oxigênio), conforme prescrição médica ou protocolo da instituição, para avaliar o estado de saúde do paciente e detectar alterações precoces.
  • Fazer e trocar curativos simples conforme a necessidade ou prescrição médica, para promover a cicatrização e prevenir infecções.
  • Administrar medicamentos (oral, intramuscular, intravenoso, subcutâneo), conforme prescrição médica, para tratar, controlar ou prevenir doenças e promover a recuperação do paciente.

  • Auxiliar médicos e enfermeiros em procedimentos (suturas, punções, intubações), conforme necessidade ou emergência, para garantir a segurança e eficiência dos procedimentos médicos.
  • Realizar eletrocardiograma (ECG), conforme prescrição médica, para detectar e monitorar condições cardíacas como arritmias e infartos.

Centro Cirúrgico

  • Exercer funções de circulante auxiliando o cirugião e equipe cirúrgica na montagem de sala e administrando os materiais da cirurgia.
  • Dar suporte ao Enfermeiro na triagem, preparando e orientando os pacientes.
  • Recepcionar o paciente, preparar e dilatar pupilas para cirurgia oftalmológica, conforme prescrição médica, utilizando colírios, para preparar o paciente para o procedimento cirúrgico.
  • Controlar e solicitar rouparia, materiais e medicamentos utilizados na área.
  • Fazer a lavagem e preparação do material de cirgurgia.

Endoscopia

  • Auxiliar a equipe médica na realização dos exames.
  • Fazer a desinfecção e controle dos aparelhos utilizados nos exames.
  • Preparar o paciente e realizar montagem da sala para os exames.

Ambulatório

  • Organizar e dar suporte para os médicos de procedimentos em consultório.
  • Organizar e repor estoque de materiais, medicamentos e aparelhos necessários para os atendimentos.
  • Organizar agendas médicas, diariamente, para garantir a organização das consultas e procedimentos médicos.
