title: Sr. Director of Pre-Award
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Pre-Award (Outgoing Team) leads the university’s pre-award research administration function, ensuring efficient, compliant, and service-oriented proposal development and submission. The role is responsible for managing all outgoing proposals, outgoing subawards, and consultant agreements, providing direct support to faculty and research administrators while maintaining consistent quality, compliance, and operational standards across the outgoing pre-award lifecycle. As a key leader in the Sponsored Programs Office (SPO), this position provides supervisory oversight of pre-award staff, works closely with institutional leadership, and aligns pre-award services with federal, sponsor, and institutional requirements.

Supervisory Authority

  • Directly supervises Pre-Award Research Administrators and administrative support staff, including setting priorities, managing workloads, and ensuring consistent application of standards across the team.
  • Provides oversight of outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements within the Sponsored Programs Office.
  • Provides training, mentorship, and professional development to pre-award staff to ensure continuous improvement in research administration, including coaching on performance expectations and process adherence.
  • Oversees faculty engagement and training efforts, ensuring faculty and research administrators receive guidance on proposal development and compliance.
  • Collaborates with the Senior Director of Pre-Award – Incoming team to establish best practices and ensure seamless pre-award operations.

Nature And Scope

  • Reports directly to the Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Sponsored Programs and works in close collaboration with the Senior Director of Pre-Award (Incoming team) to align pre-award strategy with the university’s research mission.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for faculty and research centers on proposal development and submission.
  • Leads the university’s outgoing proposal and outgoing subaward administration, ensuring that all submissions meet sponsor, federal, and institutional requirements.
  • Engages with Post-Award teams, Research Compliance, and Legal to support seamless research administration processes.
  • Cross-Coverage Clause: While the Senior Director of the Outgoing team primarily oversees outgoing proposals and subawards, they are expected to cross-train and collaborate with the Senior Director of the Incoming team to ensure seamless research administration operations. In the absence of the Senior Director of the Incoming team, the Senior Director of the Outgoing team may assume temporary oversight of incoming awards and agreements to maintain compliance, efficiency, and sponsor relations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leadership & Operations Management
    • Manages all outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, ensuring timely and compliant submission and execution to federal, corporate, and foundation sponsors.
    • Implements workflow improvements and efficiency strategies to strengthen proposal development, intake quality, and routing discipline.
    • Establishes and enforces best practices and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for proposal development, submission, and outgoing agreement processing.
    • Monitors aging actions and escalates items at risk of deadline or compliance exposure, maintaining visibility into workload distribution and backlog status.
    • Serves as a liaison between faculty, research centers, and sponsors, ensuring successful proposal submission.
  • Proposal Development & Compliance
    • Provides technical assistance and strategic guidance for complex and high-value research proposals.
    • Reviews and ensures all outgoing proposals adhere to sponsor guidelines and university policies.
    • Oversees outgoing subaward and consultant agreements and compliance, including but not limited to pre-award subrecipient monitoring, required documentation, and risk assessments.
    • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal research regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Faculty & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Develops and leads training programs for faculty, research administrators, and pre-award staff on proposal development, budgeting, and compliance.
    • Supports outreach initiatives to increase faculty participation in externally funded research.
    • Provides consultation and guidance to Principal Investigators (PIs) on proposal requirements and submission processes.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making & Performance Monitoring
    • Tracks proposal volume, success rates, sponsor trends, turnaround times, and backlog aging, using data to drive strategic and operational improvements.
    • Implements research analytics tools to measure performance and optimize pre-award workflows.
    • Provides regular reports to the AVP of Sponsored Programs on proposal activity, funding trends, operational efficiency, and documentation quality.
  • Strategic Process Leadership
    • Leads process design, policy implementation, and operational strengthening across the outgoing pre-award function.
    • Engages in strategic discussions with the AVP and Senior Director (Incoming team) on research administration improvements and institutional priorities.
    • Identifies and addresses systemic workflow gaps, documentation risks, and handoff failures to ensure audit-ready operations.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership & Team Management: Ability to supervise, train, and develop pre-award staff; set priorities; redistribute work during absences; and maintain team stability in a high-volume environment.

title: Geosupport Lead
description:
Overview

Welcome to PXGEO PXGEO is an innovative marine geophysical service provider combining the strengths of ocean bottom and towed streamer seismic data acquisition techniques to deliver seamless subsurface imaging for a sustainable future.

Role Official company title is Technical Lead - Geophysics. We are seeking an experienced Geophysicist to provide technical geophysical support across the Company's Sales & Marketing, Operations, and Engineering Development teams. This role plays a critical part in ensuring exceptional data quality throughout the full project lifecycle and will be responsible for data quality assurance from the initial receipt of tenders through to the delivery of final survey products to the Client. This position requires close collaboration with internal departments to ensure surveys meet technical, commercial, and client expectations.

Key responsibilities

  • Support for Sales
    • Provide alternative and/or additional survey designs or layouts to more efficiently meet clients\' geophysical objectives
    • Review incoming data acquisition tender requests and provide technical responses, including technical exceptions, survey area maps, shooting plan scenarios and source modelling
    • Complete project time and motion estimations where required
  • Support for Marketing
    • Contribute to the technical standing of the company through publications at industry conferences and in industry journals
    • Assist in the development of the company Geophysical Initiatives
    • Attend Client Meetings as required. As an expert, participate in meetings and contribute actively to development of client relations and participate in the promotion of the company\'s image of excellence
    • Compile and present geophysical and technical slides, and present Company geophysical initiatives
  • Support for Operations
    • Prepare project start-up documentation including preplots, shooting plans, operational maps, and parameter sheets as appropriate for the seismic method
    • Attend seismic project kick-off, start-up and close-out meetings if required to represent Geophysical Services and Technology group
    • Review end of job report for accuracy and quality
    • Problem dataset analysis with appropriate reporting
    • Assist in the design, writing and implementation of procedures, methods and technical content that facilitate good survey practices and the safe and effective operations of the Geophysical Department. Contribute to continual improvement and review of working practices and standards
    • Propose and implement best practices, new technologies and methodologies in QC processing offshore and geophysical support onshore
    • Ensure the geophysical quality of projects by assisting offshore QC Geophysicists to optimize sequences and parameters, contribute to the test and QC plan adapted to the project
    • Monitor Geophysical-related downtime and inform Management of potential means to reduce downtime
    • Review detailed analysis and provide recommendations on a weekly basis for ongoing projects. Recommendations should contain the following:
      • Acquired data quality Vessel performance
      • Coverage and Infill
    • Monitor the health of the deployed receiver spread
    • Provide support for and where necessary supervision of any production processing efforts for the project whether carried out onboard or by the third party onshore
  • Support for Engineering Development
    • Provide geophysical input into the research and development portfolio
    • In cooperation with Engineering Development, conduct technical studies and tests in order to validate new technologies and methodologies
    • Assist in planning, execution and analysis of acquisition technology tests
    • Develop and design source and receiver configurations
  • General
    • Keep abreast of changes in seismic data acquisition and processing technology
    • Administration of the Company seismic project documentation sharing portal and maintain all ITT & Project location history
    • Ensure department\'s assets are tracked and maintained according to Company procedures and best practices
    • Maintain the necessary software toolbox

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Geophysics, Geoscience, Physics, or a related discipline
  • At least 5+ years of extensive experience in geophysical operations including seismic acquisition and QC, within onshore and offshore environments
  • Exposure to marine seismic survey methods and technologies relating to all aspects of seismic surveys with a focus on geophysical method, and processing
  • In-depth knowledge of modern geophysical acquisition technologies and a solid understanding of emerging processing methods and their impact on acquisition design
  • Experience managing geophysical service providers and key technical suppliers
  • Solid understanding of EHSQ principles, compliance with management systems, and delivery of high-quality services
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to act as the primary technical interface for Operations

title: CFD Engineer, Sustainability
description:
Overview

Job Description The Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) engineer belongs to the Global Sustainability Team focusing on ship energy and operational efficiency. As a Sustainability team engineer, you will contribute to the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. The CFD engineer is expected to interact with multiple parts of the organization, taking a lead role in driving the ABS Global Sustainability Advisory CFD services related to the hydrodynamic and aerodynamic performance of a vessel. The role requires involvement in international projects and supporting clients to improve the overall environmental performance of their vessels. Our Risk Management team in Brazil supports clients in improving the safety, reliability, and resilience of their assets and operations. We work across CAPEX and OPEX projects, supporting customers in upstream, midstream, downstream, and emerging sectors such as BESS, CCS, and hydrogen.

What You Will Do

  • Execute CFD services to marine clients related to hull and propeller modification, hydrodynamic and aerodynamic energy efficiency technologies, trim optimization, and performance.
  • Contribute to studies that influence important engineering and operational decisions, while also helping shape the next generation of technical capability within the team.
  • Lead or support a variety of technical safety and risk studies, including: Fire and explosion modelling, Flame detector allocation, Exhaust and ventilation dispersion, Smoke and gas dispersion, Flare radiation analysis, Helideck turbulence studies and Process safety and risk studies such as HAZOP, HAZID, LOPA, Bow-Tie, Safety Case, and EERA.
  • Be a focal point of contact for CFD-related services in ABS Global Sustainability: Interact with clients to identify/resolve problems in technical expertise.
  • Maintain and improve ABS numerical calculation tools concerning the CFD services.
  • Manage client projects related to CFD: Take the lead in projects related to vessel performance CFD services.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate team members to ensure client needs are met.
  • Develop numerical analysis-based services and products.
  • Contribute to the development of tools and services for ABS Global Sustainability.
  • Initiate and participate in joint development/industry projects with clients or OEMs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of national and international regulatory developments with environmental protection and update the Global Sustainability team accordingly. May contribute to authoring ABS publications and thought leadership documents.
  • Conduct seminars and workshops as requested.
  • Stay updated on emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions.
  • Support the associated service delivery across all geographic locations of Sustainability (Houston, Athens, Copenhagen, Singapore).
  • Maintain awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Work as a team member or autonomously, as required.
  • Manage or support project execution, schedules, quality, and technical delivery.
  • Interact directly with clients to discuss technical issues, project progress, and solutions.
  • Support proposal development and technical presentations.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants, collaborating with teams in Brazil and other offices globally.

Requirements

What You Will Need

  • Degree in Engineering, preferably Chemical or Mechanical Engineering
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience
  • Strong experience in advanced CFD modelling applied to risk and safety
  • Experience in analyses related to fire, explosion, dispersion, and detection studies
  • Fluent Portuguese and English
  • Strong report writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality technical work in a consulting environment

Education and Experience Desired

  • M.Sc. or postgraduate qualification in Safety Engineering, Process Safety, or related field
  • Experience in QRA, vulnerability analysis, PHAST, and/or SAFETI
  • Knowledge of Human Factors, including: Human Reliability Analysis (HRA), Human Factors Engineering (HFE)
  • Familiarity with Petro-HRA
  • Familiarity with Brazilian regulations and industry requirements, including Petrobras guidelines, ANP requirements, and applicable NRs
  • Experience across upstream, downstream, and midstream
  • Knowledge of Python, VBA, or other programming/automation tools
  • Interest in digitalization and technical innovation
  • Spanish language skills

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Track record in applying CFD and data analysis software tools to deliver technical solutions to clients.
  • FLACS
  • KFX
  • Ansys Fluent
  • Ansys CFX
  • Hydrodynamics and naval architecture knowledge; aerodynamics is a plus
  • Working knowledge of Linux and CAD packages (e.g., Rhino 3D)
  • Knowledge of additional software: OpenFoam, StarCCM+, Paraview
  • Proficiency with scripting and coding languages for pre-processing, post-processing, and data analytics (Python or other)
  • Ability to solve complex problems and work independently or in a team
  • Ability to manage project requirements, budgets, schedules, and technical work
  • Experience with marine or offshore applications
  • Experience with programming and advanced MS Office use
  • Client presentation capability
  • Excellent communication skills (oral and written)
  • Commitment to ethical business practices per corporate policies
  • Proficiency in English
  • Ability to develop working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, regulations, and safety policy

Reporting Relationships

Reporting directly to the operations manager.

About Us

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and related safety, quality, and environmental services. We support organizations facing evolving regulations and technologies, with a focus on safety, reliability, and efficiency. We are committed to supporting the global energy transition at sea and related innovations.

Equal Opportunity

The ABS Group of Companies is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits discrimination based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status, veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics protected by law.

Notice

ABS will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement signed by Human Resources. Any resume or submission provided without a valid MSA will be considered ABS property.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Assistant Director – Military and Veterans Services (ADMVS) directs, plans, and organizes all veterans’ services initiatives. The ADMVS assists with and helps lead the department's vision, goals, and objectives for the department. The ADMVS reports to the Director of Student Services.

Nature And Scope

The primary function of the ADMVS is to assume responsibility for most activities, procedures, and policies related to the Howard University Military connected community, including assisting with the department’s budget and staff. This position provides strategic direction for the assigned department under the general guidance of the Director of Student Services.

The position is responsible for implementing the policies and procedures to assist the Howard University Military & Veterans Community. The ADMVS performs the administrative and technical duties required to establish and maintain a program to assist Military connected individuals in obtaining educational, financial, social services and other benefits available through the Federal, State and local legislation. This position requires evening and weekend hours and accessibility as student needs arise.

Supervisory Accountability

Direct supervision of two Veterans Affairs Coordinators (Certifying School Officials). Supervision of one Veteran Resource Coordinator.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as point of contact for veteran's educational programs, policies, procedures and regulations
  • Serve as liaison between HU and the VA for eligibility for veteran students
  • Develop and expand the University's relationships with other U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and other services agencies
  • Provide accurate information to all interested parties regarding current educational benefits and programs which are provided by federal and state government and local agencies to support veterans
  • Counsel students and parents concerning eligibility and benefits available under various programs
  • Ensure compliance with federal and state government reporting requirements related to veterans’ educational benefits
  • Manage and monitor schedule changes, major changes, withdrawals, audits and inapplicable courses for appropriate changes in benefits
  • Implement control measures to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of certification
  • Establish and maintain student VA files
  • Coordinate with the office of Admission and Recruiting, Records and Registration, Financial Aid, and Disabilities Services to improve the enrollment process for military connected students
  • Recommend, implement, and administer methods and procedures to enhance recruitment efforts
  • Develop a working knowledge of ASU academic programs that are of interest to veterans’ students
  • Evaluate U.S. Armed Forces transcripts for transfer credit and transfer equivalencies
  • Develop and maintain the department's website
  • Represent the University on committees and advisory groups that work to advance and enhance VA benefits, and state and regional organizations that assist veteran students with four-year college graduation
  • Actively promote programs that engage veterans and the campus community
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Senior Leaders within The Office of Student Services and Student Affairs

Collaboration and Partnership

  • Partner with the Howard University Bursar’s office for seamless and streamlined communication
  • Collaborate and coordinate with the financial aid office
  • Provide recommendations, tools and resources for faculty and staff to assist them in how to support military connected students
  • Develop, cultivate, and sustain collaborative and effective working relationships with key stakeholders outside the Division of Student Affairs

Core Competencies

  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, critical thinking, professional judgment, oral and written communication
  • Demonstrated ability to work with a diverse and inclusive student population
  • Self-directed; self-motivated individual who can work autonomously with minimal supervision while managing multiple situations
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, follow through, meet deadlines, and make professional decisions
  • Ability to work independently, collaboratively across multiple offices and in a team environment
  • Flexibility and accessibility particularly as it relates to responding to and attending to student needs
  • Demonstrated work ethic that illustrates integrity, ethics, sound professional judgment and an appreciation for diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Competent and comfortable with technology and ability to utilize data to inform decisions
  • Strong writing, editing, and presentation skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive matters with exceptionally good judgment and discretion
  • Experience supervising employees, including hiring and evaluation

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in education, training, and experience
  • 3-5 years of experience with student support initiatives in higher education or a similar setting
  • Previous Military Services

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Counseling, Public Health, Education, Higher Education, Student Affairs, Social Work, or a related field
  • 5-7 years related experience
  • Ability to build knowledge base of national trends and best practices

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000

No time de Experiência Publicitária Globoplay, temos uma missão dupla e essencial: garantimos que a publicidade seja relevante e integrada à experiência, ao mesmo tempo em que atuamos como os guardiões da Voz do Usuário . Nosso objetivo é equilibrar as metas de negócio com uma jornada fluida, prazerosa e de alta qualidade para quem nos assiste.

Diversidade: Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

  • Liderar a estratégia de "Voz do Usuário" (VoC): Coletar, analisar e transformar feedbacks de usuários em insights acionáveis para o produto como um todo, garantindo que as dores dos consumidores sejam ouvidas e priorizadas.
  • Mapear fricções e oportunidades: Olhar para a jornada completa do usuário no Globoplay, identificando pontos críticos tanto na navegação geral quanto na exposição publicitária.

  • Governança de Insights: Organizar rituais de acompanhamento e levar a "visão do usuário" para mesas de decisão, sustentando a execução de frentes estratégicas com base em dados reais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração, UX ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com Programas de Voz do Usuário (VoC) ou Customer Experience (CX): Expertise em metodologias de escuta e análise de sentimento do cliente.

  • Familiaridade com o ecossistema de publicidade digital.

title: REMOTE - Senior Data Engineer (SQL DBA)
description:
Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Primary DBA Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency.
  • Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards.

Team Responsibilities

  • Participate in daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure alignment with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge‑case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

  • This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full‑time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need.
  • We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands‑on environment and grow into long‑term technical leadership.

Additional Information

  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English.
  • M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization.

The Core Services Team builds and maintains the mission‑critical, high‑throughput, and fault‑tolerant foundational services that power the entire Uber platform. This includes global‑scale services for Safety, Identity, Payments, and other core business logic.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader who operates with a broad scope, influencing the technical direction not just within your team but across multiple dependent platform and product teams. Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with significant experience in designing, building, and operating large‑scale, high‑availability distributed systems in a production environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • SRE Principles: Deep experience with site reliability engineering, including error budgeting, SLO/SLA definition, and building self‑healing systems.

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente otimização de processos operacionais e soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir a adequada implementação dos Programas de Compliance, incluindo os temas de integridade e direitos humanos, por meio da condução de avaliações de riscos de processos, acompanhamento de controles e monitoramento de indicadores de eficácia, assegurando aderência à Lei Anticorrupção (Lei nº 12.846/13 e Decreto nº 11.129/22), à legislação de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro (Lei nº 9.613/98), às obrigações regulatórias aplicáveis, às boas práticas de governança corporativa, às diretrizes de direitos humanos e às principais referências internacionais, como FCPA (EUA) e UK Bribery Act (Reino Unido).
  • Atuar em interface com as áreas da Companhia, apoiando iniciativas e projetos, com visão orientada ao negócio e à gestão de riscos, contribuindo para a viabilização das operações com segurança, aderência às normas e tomada de decisão responsável.
  • Apoiar a elaboração, revisão e aprimoramento de políticas, normas e procedimentos, assegurando sua aderência às exigências regulatórias e promovendo a melhoria contínua e a eficiência dos processos da Companhia, com fortalecimento do ambiente de controle.
  • Preparar materiais e evidências para auditorias internas, externas e projetos, bem como apoiar o mapeamento, avaliação e testes de controles de compliance em processos críticos, executando walkthroughs e testes de amostragem, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e tempestividade das entregas.
  • Apoiar a análise e resposta a consultas relacionadas aos temas de Compliance (doações e patrocínios, brindes e hospitalidade, conflito de interesses, contratações…), sob a ótica de riscos de integridade, reputacionais e regulatórios, elaborando pareceres de compliance e orientando as áreas quanto às salvaguardas e aos controles aplicáveis.
  • Acompanhar, analisar e reportar indicadores (KPI's) do Programa de Compliance.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de reports internos de Compliance.
  • Apoiar as áreas na elaboração de reportes externos, como o Formulário de Referência (CVM) e o Relatório de Sustentabilidade.
  • Apoiar a execução do programa de gestão de riscos de compliance, incluindo a atualização do Mapa de Riscos e Controles, com base em frameworks de gestão de riscos.
  • Realizar testes periódicos de controles internos, avaliando a aderência aos processos, ao desenho e à efetividade dos controles, conforme a matriz de riscos, bem como elaborar e acompanhar os planos de ação decorrentes dos resultados obtidos.
  • Conduzir e monitorar processos de due diligence de terceiros (fornecedores, clientes, embarcações, patrocínios, doações, entre outros), com base na metodologia e abordagem de risco da Companhia, incluindo, quando aplicável, critérios de avaliação como análise de estrutura societária, identificação de beneficiários finais, verificação de exposição a sanções internacionais e avaliação de histórico reputacional, em linha com referências internacionais como FCPA (EUA), UK Bribery Act (Reino Unido) e regimes de sanções (OFAC, União Europeia), com elaboração de pareceres de compliance e registro estruturado das informações, garantindo a consistência das avaliações e o suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Apoiar a gestão do Canal de Integridade.
  • Apoiar e conduzir treinamentos de compliance para áreas da Companhia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica, graduação em Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas; desejável pós‑graduação em Compliance, Governança ou Gestão de Riscos.
  • Certificações desejáveis CCEP, CPC‑A; auditor/implementer ISO 37001/37301 e certificações em gestão de riscos (como ISO 31000 ou certificações correlatas).
  • Conhecimentos específicos sólidos em Due diligence de Integridade, na Lei nº 12.846/2013 e no Decreto nº 11.129/2022, com familiaridade com legislações internacionais anticorrupção e antissuborno, como FCPA (EUA) e UK Bribery Act (Reino Unido), bem como com regimes de sanções internacionais (ex.: OFAC, União Europeia) e diretrizes e referências nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis, incluindo o Programa de Integridade da CGU e as diretrizes da OCDE; experiência em controles internos, matriz de riscos e indicadores (KRIs e KPIs), incluindo vivência em avaliações de maturidade de programas de integridade (ex.: Pró‑Ética e Ethos).
  • Conhecimento em proteção de dados e privacidade (LGPD), e desejável familiaridade com a regulação aplicável ao setor de óleo e gás (ANP).
  • Ferramentas e sistemas: conhecimento em ferramentas de produtividade, análise de dados e automação, incluindo uso de inteligência artificial aplicada ao trabalho, automação de tarefas (ex.: Power Automate) e elaboração de dashboards (ex.: Power BI), bem como familiaridade com Python (desejável) e com ferramentas de due diligence de integridade.

title: MEDICO PNEUMOLOGISTA DIARISTA- HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Overview

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes. O Hospital Cardoso Fontes é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atividades da especialidade de pneumologia, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, anamnese, exame físico, propedêutica instrumental;
  • Interpretar dados de exame clínico e exames complementares e diagnosticar estado de saúde;
  • Discutir diagnóstico, prognóstico, tratamento e prevenção com usuários, responsáveis e familiares;
  • Planejar e prescrever tratamento e praticar intervenções clínicas e cirúrgicas quando couber;
  • Prescrever medicamentos, hemoderivados e cuidados especiais;
  • Implementar ações para promoção da saúde, elaborar e avaliar prontuários, emitir receitas;
  • Participar de equipes interdisciplinares e multiprofissionais, realizando atividades em conjunto, tais como: discussão de casos, reuniões administrativas, matriciamento, entre outras;
  • Participar, conforme a política interna da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (SMS), de projetos, cursos, eventos, comissões, convênios e programas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão;
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade;
  • Participar de programa de treinamento, quando convocado;
  • Trabalhar segundo normas técnicas de segurança, qualidade, produtividade, higiene e preservação ambiental;
  • Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática;
  • Estar em consonância com as diretrizes de práticas médicas baseadas em evidências publicadas;
  • Preencher adequadamente e de forma legível todos os formulários padronizados pelo serviço manualmente ou de forma digital;
  • Registrar Estatística Internacional de Doenças (CID) e justificativas nos Serviços de Apoio Diagnóstico Terapêutico (SADT) e guias de referência;
  • Sinalizar prioridade de encaminhamento nas solicitações (alta, média ou baixa);
  • Realizar a contra referência do paciente à Unidade Básica de Saúde de sua referência após a alta ambulatorial ou durante o acompanhamento dos casos crônicos que permanecerem por mais tempo em acompanhamento no serviço conforme Código de Ética Médica;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD;
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Requisitos e qualificações

Graduação em Medicina com diploma reconhecido pelo MEC.

Residência médica em Pediatria em pneumologista

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Escala: 20h semanais

Horário: a combinar

Responsibilities

  • Prestar suporte na elaboração e revisão dos documentos de medição contratual e registros operacionais.
  • Interagir com fiscais para acompanhar análise do desempenho operacional das operações.
  • Participar e apoiar a realização de Minutas de cartas externas e/ou documentos internos de controles e durações operacionais.
  • Calcular os indicadores de Desempenho da gerência relacionados às Embarcações e realizar análise crítica das operações finalizadas, bem como o acumulado no ano, inserindo comentários no local definido. Realizar estudos de projeção/simulações dos indicadores de Desempenho da gerência.
  • Realizar conferência e ajuste de Painéis em BI, quando necessário. Participar de reuniões de passagem de serviço entre Planejamento e Operação.
  • Realizar análise crítica dos documentos recebidos do Planejamento (ex.: APRs, MDs, APOs e SOPs) para retornar sobre a qualidade, propor melhorias e otimizações. Acompanhar o desenrolar das operações com embarcações, mantendo-se informado sobre embarque de materiais, situação técnica de equipamentos e ferramentas, interface com outros setores, entre outros. Realizar validação/aprovação de documentos gerados durante a operação, com base nas melhores práticas operacionais, de segurança e nos procedimentos (exemplos: Relatórios de Anomalia, Verificações de Qualidade de Procedimento, Gestões de Mudança, Sugestões de Melhoria).
  • Trabalhar de forma proativa para conhecer as informações técnicas das ferramentas e equipamentos envolvidos nas operações, participando de discussões técnicas com outros setores. Compreender a rotina da gerência operacional e os sistemas informatizados utilizados.
  • Conhecer os procedimentos que afetem diretamente sua atividade, especialmente aqueles sob a gestão da gerência setorial em que estiver prestando serviço.
  • Participar, dar suporte técnico e soluções de engenharia nas contingências operacionais, considerando as melhores práticas operacionais e de segurança.
  • Ao final das operações, realizar análise de desempenho para identificar pontos positivos a replicar e pontos negativos, criando ações para evitar reincidência, divulgando lições aprendidas em reuniões ou fóruns.
  • Apoiar outras gerências, quando solicitado, para fornecer suporte técnico nas fases de projeto, planejamento e operação.
  • Conduzir reuniões designadas e se informar proativamente sobre a condução, postura e registro em ata.
  • Dar suporte na gestão e atendimento dos padrões relacionados às atividades em Embarcações, revisando ou emitindo-os quando necessário.
  • Diligenciar, emitir e/ou executar ações de Gestão de Mudanças, conforme padrões aplicáveis.
  • Participar de RACs (Reuniões de Análise Críticas) relacionadas às Embarcações e consolidar o material para RACs com foco em Desempenho.
  • Coordenar e/ou participar da APR (Análise Preliminar de Risco) das operações em Embarcações, conforme padrões aplicáveis.
  • Coordenar e/ou participar do tratamento de anomalias em Embarcações, emitindo Relatório de Tratamento de Anomalia com plano de ação, causas básicas, ações de bloqueio e abrangência. Realizar o preenchimento de documentações para órgãos reguladores como ANP e IBAMA (p. ex., Relatório Detalhado de Incidente - RDI e Relatório de Atendimento a Incidente de Poluição por Óleo - RAIPO).

Capacitação e Qualificações

  • Graduação de nível superior concluída em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mechatrônica, Engenharia Metalúrgica ou Engenharia de Materiais.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos, relacionada a atividades com equipamentos submarinos em barcos da área submarina (PLSVs, RSVs, SESV etc.).
  • Registro no Conselho de Classe (CREA).
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Observação: outras formações em Engenharia são aceitas, desde que acompanhadas de certidão emitida pelo respectivo Conselho de Classe atestando a posse de todas as atribuições profissionais das Engenharias citadas.

Conhecimentos Específicos

  • Domínio pleno de ferramenta de planilha eletrônica (pacote Microsoft Office – incluindo Power BI e SharePoint) com habilidade para geração de painéis dinâmicos e sites.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de análise de riscos, tais como HAZOP, APR, FMEA/FMECA e Diagramas Bow-Tie. Capacidade de coordenar a elaboração de uma APR.
  • Gerenciamento de Mudança (MOC, Management of Change).
  • Conhecimento de normas e regulamentos pertinentes a equipamentos submarinos, tais como API 6A / ISO 10423, API 17D / ISO 13628-4, API 17G / ISO 13628-7, ISO 13628-8, ISO 19901-6, ABNT NR 11, DNVGL-RP-N103, DNVGL-ST-N001, SGSS e SGIP, entre outros.
  • Domínio do SAP: módulos de materiais (MM) e de manutenção (PM).

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.

Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupos de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros.

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSO units and associated equipment. As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency.   • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.

Key Competencies

  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

description:
A missão desse cargo será auxiliar na prestação de cuidados aos pacientes em um ambiente hospitalar. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem a assistência direta aos pacientes, a realização de procedimentos técnicos e a colaboração com a equipe de saúde.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar as rotinas de enfermagem da Instituição (passagem de plantão, registro de intercorrências, notificações de eventos, etc.);
  • Manter o posto de Enfermagem organizado para as atividades laborativas;
  • Receber, conferir, administrar e devolver as medicações prescritas;
  • Executar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem – Prescrição de Enfermagem e Plano de Cuidados;
  • Realizar os registros seguros da sua prática profissional;
  • Realizar curativo simples e comunicar ao enfermeiro;
  • Preparar o paciente para exames e tratamentos internos e externos, se houver necessidade;
  • Observar, reconhecer e descrever sinais e sintomas, ao nível de sua qualificação, sempre comunicando ao Enfermeiro.
  • Executar tratamentos especificamente prescritos, ou de rotina, além de outras atividades de enfermagem;
  • Ministrar medicamentos por via oral, IM e uso tópico relatando quaisquer alterações e/ou intercorrências ao Enfermeiro responsável;
  • Administrar nebulização, enema e calor ou frio conforme prescrição;
  • Realizar o controle de pacientes e contactantes de doenças transmissíveis, sob a supervisão do Enfermeiro;
  • Colher material (Urina e Fezes) para exames laboratoriais por método convencional;
  • Prestar cuidados de enfermagem pré e pós-procedimentos;
  • Executar atividades de limpeza e desinfecção de materiais;
  • Verificar e registrar sinais vitais para monitorar o estado de saúde dos pacientes, como temperatura, pressão arterial, pulso, respiração e glicemia capilar;
  • Realizar registros precisos das informações dos pacientes, incluindo sinais vitais, medicamentos administrados, procedimentos realizados e observações relevantes sobre o estado do paciente;
  • Apoiar na realização da contenção mecânica;
  • Realizar rondas conforme plano de cuidados;
  • Possuir escuta ativa e sensível;
  • Realizar manejo e abordagem aos pacientes com instabilidade psíquica;
  • Prestar cuidados de higiene e conforto ao paciente;
  • Zelar pela sua segurança, controle de pertences de riscos (giletes, fio dental, removedor esmalte, esmaltes etc.);

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. The Patient Care Coordinator provides frontline administrative and clinical support to HIV primary care services, with a specialized focus on coordinating long-acting injectable HIV therapies. This role ensures seamless scheduling, medication tracking, patient engagement, and operational support to promote continuity of care and optimize viral suppression outcomes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, patient-centered, and experienced in clinical coordination within a fast-paced healthcare setting.

External contacts include a variety of third party payers, medical organizations, patients and other healthcare personnel.

  • Assist with daily clinic workflows to ensure efficient operations.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives and performance reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Attention to detail
  • Patient engagement and communication
  • Care coordination
  • Confidentiality and HIPAA compliance
  • Team collaboration
  • Problem-solving and proactive follow-up

Minimum Requirements

  • Current certification as a Medical Assistant (CMA or equivalent).
  • High school diploma or equivalent (Associate degree preferred).
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in a clinical or healthcare setting (HIV or infectious disease experience preferred).
  • Experience with EMR systems.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.

  • Commitment to patient-centered care and health equity.

description:
Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI – Light – Rio de Janeiro

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia.
  • Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS).
  • Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT).
  • Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes.
  • Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho.
  • Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP).
  • Promover campanhas de conscientização em segurança e boas práticas para colaboradores e fornecedores.
  • Interagir com áreas regulatórias, auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de conformidade.
  • Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação (obrigatório).
  • Certificações valorizadas: CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Security, ou IEC 62443.
  • Experiência comprovada em:
    • Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias.
    • Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos.
    • Resiliência Operacional: continuidade de negócios, backup, DRP.
  • Vivência em empresas de energia ou setores críticos será diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial aplicada à Segurança da Informação (uso de IA para detecção de ameaças, análise comportamental e automação de resposta a incidentes).

Informações adicionais

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxilio farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Wellhub
  • Seguro de vida
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de treinamentos

description:
Escopo geográfico do cargo:

Nacional

Área geográfica:

Brasil, Rio de Janeiro

Impacto do cargo nos resultados financeiros:

O cargo atua em um mercado regulado. O Brasil apresenta alta complexidade regulatória e está sujeito a mudanças frequentes. Além disso, SOX é uma regulamentação global.

Stakeholders relacionados ao cargo:

  • Colaboradores responsáveis pelos controles SOX (execução e validação);
  • CODIR da Filial;
  • Equipe de Controle Interno e Governança da Matriz;
  • Equipe de Auditoria Interna da Matriz;
  • Equipe de Auditoria de Joint Ventures da Matriz;
  • Parceiros de Joint Venture;
  • Nível de contato: Nível 2 – requer capacidade de influenciar e convencer;

Horizonte de Reflexão:

Horizonte: Médio prazo (1–3 anos).

Objetivo: Implementar diretrizes por meio da otimização de processos.

Responsabilidades

  • Executar as atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro, visando salvaguardar a integridade das pessoas, preservar o meio ambiente e os recursos, e contribuir para a eficiência energética e descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da empresa.
  • Apoiar o(a) Gerente de Governança Corporativa no planejamento anual (missões de auditoria da matriz, plano de auditoria, KPIs, etc.).
  • Coordenar, motivar, liderar e desenvolver a equipe de Auditoria Interna, acompanhando seu desempenho e desenvolvimento de carreira.
  • Estimular inovação e novas ideias nas atividades de auditoria.
  • Garantir que as atividades estejam em conformidade com os padrões de Governança e acordos de Joint Venture (Compliance/Integridade, Sistema de Gestão da Companhia – CMS, Sarbanes-Oxley – SOX, requisitos regulatórios, acordos com parceiros de JV, etc.).
  • Conduzir auditorias internas (JV, BV, controles SOX e processos locais), incluindo planejamento, execução, delegação, reporte e acompanhamento.
  • Assegurar o acompanhamento da implementação das recomendações de auditoria (Matriz, Interna e JV) e revisar o MEMO trimestral de follow-up de auditoria.
  • Garantir a atualização regular das ferramentas de auditoria (ex.: ferramenta JVADB, arquivo ACI, etc.).
  • Coordenar o planejamento anual de auditoria de Joint Ventures e comunicar adequadamente internamente a e aos parceiros (processo de exercício do direito de auditoria).
  • Coordenar os testes dos controles SOX, incluindo planejamento, delegação, supervisão e revisão dos resultados (relatório de auditoria SOX).
  • Coordenar o mapeamento de riscos, garantindo o acompanhamento dos planos de ação acordados com os responsáveis.
  • Promover discussões para aumentar a conscientização sobre riscos, boas práticas de auditoria e disseminar a cultura de Auditoria Interna na afiliada.

Finalidade do Cargo:

O(A) Coordenador(a) de Auditoria Interna suporta o(a) Gerente de Governança Corporativa garantindo por meio das auditorias realizadas a conformidade com as políticas de governança da TotalEnergies, com os requisitos da legislação SOX e com os acordos de Joint-Venture.

Também conduz exercícios de mapeamento de riscos de forma proativa, assegura a responsabilização entre as áreas e fomenta uma cultura de gestão de riscos na afiliada.

O cargo é responsável pelo reporte regular de assuntos de auditoria, proporcionando ao(à) Gerente de Governança Corporativa uma visão confiável sobre processos, controles e exposição a riscos da afiliada.

Formação:

Graduação em Finanças (Contabilidade, Economia ou Administração).

Competências Técnicas:

  • Experiência em Auditoria e Finanças.
  • Forte conhecimento da legislação SOX.
  • Alta capacidade de planejamento e síntese.
  • Microsoft Office 365 – nível intermediário/avançado.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Boa comunicação e liderança de equipes
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e com prazos curtos
  • Forte pensamento crítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas
  • Capacidade de compreender a complexidade do negócio e adaptar‑se rapidamente a mudanças
  • Comunicação oral e escrita eficaz em todos os níveis.

Certificações:

  • Experiência em Auditoria Externa (Big 4 como diferencial).
  • Experiência com controles SOX.
  • Experiência no setor de Óleo & Gás.

Experiência Profissional:

Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência em Auditoria Interna ou Externa, preferencialmente no setor de Energia.

Descrição da vaga

Sobre a área:

A área é responsável pela gestão estratégica das redes sociais das marcas do Globoplay e de canais de variedades, entretenimento e esportivos do ecossistema Globo. Atua com as outras áreas de Marketing na conceituação e execução de planos de lançamento e sustentação dos projetos e campanhas alinhado aos objetivos de negócio de cada frente. Faz a gestão da relevância da presença das marcas nas plataformas com foco em engajamento com o consumidor, rentabilização e complementariedade de narrativas e públicos. Tem objetivo de criar estratégias que posicionem a Globo frente aos concorrentes dos territórios de Entretenimento, Esporte, Notícias e Streaming de forma inovadora, consistente e alinhado às mudanças de comportamento de consumo.

Diversidade:

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Modelo de trabalho:

Híbrido: Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Coordenar as frentes de Influência e Produção da área de Redes Sociais de Produtos Digitais;
  • Liderar as campanhas de marketing de influência do Globoplay e dos canais esportivos e não esportivos da Globo;
  • Atuar em parceria com outras lideranças na concepção, planejamento e gestão de projetos de lançamento e sustentação das marcas;
  • Gerenciar o time de Produção, responsável por toda a cadeia de execução: pré-produção, atuação in loco e pós-produção;
  • Garantir a entrega de conteúdos originais e coberturas de grandes eventos para os perfis do ecossistema;
  • Liderar a gestão orçamentária das campanhas de influência e dos projetos de produção.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência em Marketing de Influência, com sólido conhecimento sobre a creator economy e o mercado de influenciadores, atuando estrategicamente na conexão entre marcas e creators;
  • Vivência em planejamento e acompanhamento de produções de conteúdo audiovisual, com domínio de todas as etapas do processo, desde concepção criativa até execução e entrega final;

title: MPD Supervisor
description:
Descrição do Cargo

Reports to: Drilling Superintendent

Offshore Drilling Group

Pre-Requisite / Qualification

  • High School Diploma (U.S.) / Proof of Completion of Formal Education or Relevant Craft Certificate (where applicable)
  • Successful Military Discharge – Preferred for U.S.
  • Graduate of Trade School or University where knowledge and training acquired are applicable to job requirements – Preferred
  • Valid medical examination and vaccination certificates
  • Knowledge of all technical calculations required for the safe operation within the drilling operations.
  • Valid Well Control certificate per the standard defined on the training matrix
  • Ability to use hydraulic modelling software.
  • Computer literate including a high level of competence in Microsoft Office.
  • Require 5+ years Offshore MPD Experience
  • OEM Managed Pressure Drilling operations training

General Requirements

  • Promotes a safe and respectful work environment: proactively promotes and maintains open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel.
  • Demonstrates care for the safety and well‑being of all personnel, invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement.
  • Attends and participates in all required Safety and Operational meetings.
  • Participates fully in the annual performance appraisal process, competency assessments based on performance against Operational Discipline requirements.
  • Completes company training requirements for the MPD Supervisor job level as per the training matrix, including local and regulatory requirements.
  • Observes duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position.
  • Fully participates in emergency drills and responds to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • Performs roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre‑job meeting.
  • Understands hazards associated with the task.
  • Effectively implements control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
  • Executes all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
  • Recognises risky behaviour or conditions during tasks and calls ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure.
  • Participates in After Action Reviews to provide feedback and updates to the MPD manager.
  • Reports deviations from TOI procedures when using third‑party MPD procedures.

HSE Requirements

  • Reports all incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to supervisors.
  • Actively performs work in accordance with Company Safety Processes, e.g. START, Task Planning Risk Assessment, Prompt Card, Safe Manual Handling, Working at Heights.
  • Calls Time Out for Safety (TOFS) when the plan is unclear or an unsafe condition is observed.
  • Participates in the rigs ‘Hold the Zero’ plan.
  • Complies with company requirements to safeguard lone workers.
  • Maintains a safe and organised work area throughout all tasks.
  • Integrates the Task Planning and Risk Assessment process into all tasks.
  • Ensures subordinate personnel are trained in the START and PTW processes.
  • Communicates Company QHSE policies and programmes to and ensures they are understood by all personnel.
  • Acts in weekly meetings, FOCUS Improvement Program, and other company safety management systems.
  • Maintains high hygiene and housekeeping standards in areas of responsibility.
  • Ensures subordinates understand their roles in the Emergency Response Plan.
  • Performs required well‑control drills, conducts After Action Reviews and ensures findings are communicated.
  • Ensures DROPS inspections are conducted per the rig’s inspection programme.
  • Participates in MPD HazOp, HazID and FMECA as required by the MPD manager.

Duties

The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements.

Operations / Maintenance

  • Fully knowledgeable in all aspects of MPD operations on floating drilling vessels and MPD variants.
  • Prepares operational procedures approved by the MPD manager and secures approval for changes.
  • Performs all calculations for Kick Tolerance, IME and updates the Operations Matrix.
  • Ensures all BHA and pipe tallies are accurate, with required information entered into the MPD model.
  • Monitors maintenance, repair and installation of all MPD equipment and records inventory levels.
  • Maintains inspection and certification records for MPD equipment and tools.
  • Supports the Company Rig Maintenance System (AIM) for MPD department tasks with subsea.
  • Reviews and approves all MPD‑related Permit to Work as the responsible person for the task.
  • Supervises equipment preparation for impending MPD operations.
  • Liaises with the MPD manager on major maintenance activities such as IRJ 12‑month inspection.
  • When using the rig’s existing MGS, ensures the IME, Ops Matrix and procedures capture the maximum flow rates with a 100% safety factor.
  • Plans job activities of MPD service providers and associated activities.
  • Ensures MPD well‑control requirements are in place and supervises well‑control events.
  • Performs all MPD well‑control calculations (e.g., mud weight, circulating pressures, strokes).
  • Assists the Drilling Superintendent, Senior Toolpusher or OIM in coordinating third‑party personnel activities.
  • Prepares requisition purchase orders for equipment or parts necessary to avoid MPD downtime.
  • Ensures sufficient stock of parts and materials is maintained for MPD equipment.
  • Communicates progress of MPD and associated operations to the Drilling Superintendent, Senior Toolpusher and OIM.
  • Recommends adjustments to drilling parameters to improve MPD performance.
  • Ensures regular effective well‑MPD drills are conducted and recorded.

Personnel

  • Promotes and maintains good relationships with other departments, third‑party personnel and customer representatives.
  • Ensures MPD personnel meet training requirements per their training matrix.
  • Mentors, coaches, develops and trains crew members for MPD competence.
  • Provides leadership and motivation to drilling crews during MPD operations and applies continuous improvement.
  • Mentors the driller and assistant driller in MPD operations.
  • Carrying out MPD operations in alignment with TOI MPD training philosophy.
  • Assists in training to ensure all personnel are competent for their assigned jobs.
  • Participates fully in the annual performance appraisal process.
  • Applies appropriate accountability regarding recognition, promotion or disciplinary actions up to and including discharge.

description:
Por que a Gabriel?

16.500 câmeras. 90 milhões de leituras de placa por mês. 1 alerta por minuto direto para a polícia. 650+ suspeitos indiciados. Nossa operação no Rio processa alto volume de demandas de delegacias, batalhões e guarda municipal. Absorver esse volume com agilidade, sem comprometer qualidade, é o desafio central dessa posição. Você será responsável por analisar ocorrências em tempo real, preparar evidências que aceleram investigações e garantir que cada alerta chega à polícia registrado, rastreável e pronto para ação.

Como a Gabriel remunera?

  • Nossa Remuneração: de R$150.800 a R$226.200 /ano (incluindo 13º salário e férias)
  • Nossos Benefícios (mais de R$35.000 anuais em benefícios):
    • Cuidado completo com a sua Saúde de maneira integral:
    • Plano de Saúde Alice com atendimento 24h pelo app, cobertura nacional e acesso a hospitais de referência no país - e sem coparticipação para os colaboradores. Cobrimos também 80% do valor dos seus dependentes.

    • Totalpass TP+1 custeado integralmente para você - para quem corre, caminha, "puxa ferro", faz yoga ou quem quer começar a se cuidar. Você pode adicionar até três dependentes.

    • Descanso de Aniversário, para você curtir sua data especial como preferir.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Análise de ocorrências é o coração do trabalho
    • Fornecer às autoridades competentes informações técnicas que aceleram investigações e ajudam a dar resposta concreta à sociedade - sem nunca substituir o trabalho investigativo, que é da autoridade pública;
    • Absorver alto volume de demandas simultâneas com agilidade, sem comprometer a qualidade - no RJ, o ritmo é intenso e a capacidade de priorização faz toda a diferença;
    • Acompanhar e registrar desfechos - cada suspeito indiciado, cada pessoa encontrada, cada caso resolvido com apoio das nossas imagens é uma métrica de impacto real.
  • Atendimento institucional a autoridades públicas
    • Atender demandas de delegacias, batalhões, Guardas Municipais e demais órgãos de segurança no RJ, recebendo e processando solicitações conforme os protocolos da empresa;
    • Apoiar o time existente na gestão do fluxo de atendimento, garantindo que o aumento de volume não comprometa prazos nem padrão de entrega;
    • Participar de Conselhos Comunitários de Segurança e espaços institucionais quando necessário, representando a Gabriel de forma transparente;
    • Reportar à liderança de Relações Institucionais e Governamentais, contribuindo com insumos operacionais para o planejamento da área.
  • Compliance como base de tudo
    • Garantir que toda interação com autoridades siga os protocolos formais da empresa: canais corporativos, ofício válido, registro em HubSpot, compartilhamento por link restrito;
    • Manter padrão de documentação que suporte auditoria - todas as comunicações são individualizadas, rastreáveis e revisadas periodicamente.
  • Colaboração com o time
    • Trabalhar junto ao time do RJ e à Central 24h, garantindo fluidez entre os casos que chegam por diferentes canais;
    • Contribuir com melhorias nos processos operacionais - quem está na linha de frente com volume alto é quem melhor enxerga gargalos e oportunidades;
    • Capacitar equipes internas quando necessário, compartilhando conhecimento sobre dinâmicas de segurança e boas práticas de análise.
